periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 70-80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Teardrop-shaped tapering where the lowest point is significantly distal to the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape with a shallow posterior curvature.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness across the lateral flank, occupying roughly 30 percent of the visible torso length.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown chromatic shift in the fur of the lower lumbar and caudal regions.
